The original horizontal white bar across the abdomen is the NARROW EDGE of a shield held sideways HORIZONTALLY in front of him. The upright weapon at image-left is a LONG SPEAR sliding up and down against that shield edge, not a short stick. Crucial: shield plane is edge-on to camera; ONLY its thin horizontal metal rim is visible, NO broad vertical shield face or diamond emblem. The tall rectangular shield remains rectangular but foreshortened to a thin horizontal edge, carried across the waist like an edge-on board. Both bent arms must be clearly visible from shoulder to elbow to wrist: his image-right arm bends inward supporting shield from below, his image-left arm bends outward holding the vertical spear grip just left of the shield edge. Body and head face three-quarter left. Keep same swept-back solid gray-brown hair, matte ivory plate, navy outline, modest medium blue cloth, warm skin, same chibi tactical-map proportions, feet planted spread apart, same center. NO shiny hair or clothes.
Output is a transparent production asset sheet with FOUR isolated columns and clear gutters. Columns 1,2,3 are the three COMPLETE BODY poses, including BOTH arms, curled gripping hand, and the edge-on horizontal shield. Keep head, shoulders, torso, pelvis and legs IDENTICAL in all three, only the spear-holding forearm/hand changes: column1 hand a little lower near lower waist; column2 middle; column3 a little higher near upper waist, sliding vertically along the left end of the shield edge. The holding hand should have a tiny dark open grip for a separate shaft. DO NOT draw the spear in the first three columns because it will be attached as an independent weapon layer to prevent length flicker. Column4 is ONE standalone COMPLETE upright long medieval spear: pointed steel leaf blade at the top, continuous straight brown wooden shaft, blunt dark steel butt at bottom, no hands, no figure. Spear full length about110% of one figure's head-to-foot height, very slim shaft. The one shared spear will be composited behind each gripping hand and translated vertically unchanged. No text, labels, effects, background, shadows, extra parts or extra figures. Three whole armored bodies with clear arms and very narrow horizontal shield edge, plus one separate whole long spear.
